sub: Tasks, calendar, docs and your AI agents. Move a meeting and the rest of your day reshuffles.
Needt fits your tasks between your meetings and suggests one highlight for the day.
Give a task a length and a due date. Needt puts it on today’s schedule for you.
Connect any agent with its own token. See who is working, who is idle and what each one holds.
The Agents map shows which agent holds which task, and what is waiting on you.
Google Calendar, Outlook, iCloud and Google Tasks sync into one place.
Meetings and planned tasks on one calendar, with what is next always on top.
Today, your agents and your connections, in the same place on every screen.
